title: Wellington Cable Car Review
meta_desc: Discover the Wellington Cable Car, a 9/10 family-friendly activity with stunning harbour views, affordable prices and a beautiful botanic garden walk. Read our honest review for insider tips and booking advice.
intro: The Wellington Cable Car is a must-do activity for families visiting Wellington. This iconic attraction has been running since 1902 and offers breathtaking views of the city and harbour. With a 4-minute ride and a 45-minute walk back through the beautiful botanic garden, it's an experience not to be missed.

sections.heading: What's it like with kids?
sections.body:
The Wellington Cable Car is suitable for all ages, including babies and toddlers. The ride is relatively short and smooth, making it easy for little ones to enjoy. However, be aware that the cable car can get quite crowded, especially during peak season.

Once you reach the top, the botanic garden walk is a great way to burn off energy and enjoy the beautiful scenery. The walk is stroller-friendly, but be prepared for some hills and stairs.

sections.heading: Value for money and booking
sections.body:
The Wellington Cable Car is relatively affordable, with adult tickets costing $12 and child tickets costing $6. You can book online in advance or purchase tickets at the cable car station.

To save money, consider purchasing a family pass or looking out for special deals and discounts on the official website.

sections.heading: Insider tips and best time to visit
sections.body:
The best time to visit the Wellington Cable Car is during the week or outside of peak season to avoid the crowds. If you're visiting during the summer months, consider going early in the morning or later in the evening to avoid the heat.

Be sure to check the official website for any maintenance or closures before you go, and consider packing a picnic lunch to enjoy in the botanic garden.

sections.heading: Downsides for families
sections.body:
While the Wellington Cable Car is a great activity for families, there are a few downsides to be aware of. The cable car can get very crowded, especially during peak season, and the walk back through the botanic garden can be challenging for very young children or those with mobility issues.

Additionally, the cable car does not have any baby-changing facilities or dedicated parent rooms, so be prepared to plan ahead for feeding and changing.
